description: Python wrapper for DB Securities (DB증권) OpenAPI — Stock trading, balance, quotes, charts for Korean & US markets
rules: All DB Securities API calls use POST method
Use context manager (with/async with) for automatic cleanup
Pagination is handled via cont_yn/cont_key headers — the library merges pages automatically
All API responses include a .raw field for accessing the original response data
Token refresh is automatic when IGW00121 error code is received
